description: MLB BATTER-vs-PITCHER history from the official MLB Stats API — "how has Yordan Alvarez hit against Tanner Bibee", "<batter> career numbers vs <pitcher>". Accepts batter and pitcher NAMES (resolved automatically) or numeric ids. Returns the batter's hitting line against that specific pitcher (at-bats, hits, HR, RBI, AVG, OPS, strikeouts), split by season with career totals.

batter.description: Batter NAME (e.g. "Yordan Alvarez") or numeric MLB person id.

pitcher.description: Pitcher NAME (e.g. "Tanner Bibee") or numeric MLB person id.

season.description: Optional season year to limit to; omit for full career.

name: mlb_matchup
title: Mlb Matchup
